rights.edition: QCEW annual averages by county and NAICS industry (open data CSV, latest full year)
rights.attribution: Source: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics, Quarterly Census of Employment and Wages

vetted.notes: Counts jobs where they are, from the unemployment-insurance records of every employer: the county is the city for San Francisco and Denver, larger for the others (New York sums its five boroughs).

caveats: Cells the BLS withholds to protect an employer count as 0, so a field dominated by a few large firms can read low (Boston's industry).
Jobs where people work, not where they live, unlike the European figures.
